statement: The United States and Iran publicly confirm a ceasefire, truce, or halt-to-hostilities agreement that takes effect on a date between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-31.
resolution: TRUE if both the White House or State Department and the Iran Foreign Ministry publicly confirm a ceasefire, truce, or halt to hostilities taking effect between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-31, as reported by at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP.
failure_condition: No ceasefire, truce, or halt-to-hostilities agreement between the United States and Iran is confirmed by both governments as taking effect between 2026-09-28 and 2026-10-31.

control_basis.rule: climatological — same probability for every row drawn from the same reference class
control_basis.note: pre-registered before the outcome existed. This is the floor the forecaster arm must clear; it is not an attempt to be right.

statement: Forces of the internationally recognized Yemeni government retake the Red Sea port city of Mocha (al-Mokha) from the Houthis on a date between 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-30.
resolution: TRUE if the Yemeni government announces control of Mocha city and at least two of Reuters, AP, AFP independently report government forces holding the city, with the recapture dated between 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-30.
failure_condition: Mocha city is not retaken and held by Yemeni government forces at any point between 2026-09-28 and 2026-11-30.
